physics_conclusion: D_F in the KO-dim-6 finite spectral triple for 3 generations encodes the full SM flavor structure: 4 Yukawa blocks (up, down, electron, neutrino) + 1 Majorana block for ν_R give 22 physical flavor parameters (6+3+3 masses + 3 neutrino masses via see-saw, 4 CKM parameters, 6 PMNS parameters). Type-I see-saw m_nu ~ m_D^2/M_R yields light neutrino masses at the eV scale when M_R is at the unification scale (~10^14 GeV). CKM and PMNS matrices are exactly unitary (automatic from bi-unitary diagonalization of Yukawa matrices) with the correct number of physical parameters (3 angles + 1 CP phase for CKM; additional 2 Majorana phases for PMNS). No additional fermionic generations or mirror fermions are allowed by the block structure.
